name: banking_intent
description: Short customer-banking intent utterances (Banking77 style). Goal: utterances of the SAME intent must collapse to a heavily overlapping canonical event/state KG.
canonicalization_hints: Collapse every card surface form (card, debit card, credit card, new card) to Physical_Card unless a subtype is the explicit point; attach subtype via has_subtype.

Express the intent as the core event/state, not the speech act. 'still waiting on my card' and 'card hasn't arrived' BOTH -> (Physical_Card, has_status, Not_Received) + (Card_Delivery, has_status, Pending).
Use canonical states: Not_Received, Pending, Not_Working, Lost, Stolen, Declined, Found, Not_Linked, Damaged.
Use canonical processes: Card_Delivery, Card_Linking, Card_Replacement, Card_Tracking.
The customer is always Actor 'User'. Drop pleading/urgency ('Help!', 'panicking') — not knowledge.

inline_examples.text: I am still waiting on my card?
I need to report a stolen card
